beruhigung: You haven’t done anything wrong. With large libraries this can take a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
weiter: As soon as Ablago is ready, it continues here by itself – to sign-in or to the setup assistant.
schritt.ordner: Checking folders for files and exports
fehler.neuere-datenbank: The database comes from a newer version of Ablago ({anzahl} unknown migrations, the latest {letzte}). An older version must not use it, otherwise permissions or locks would be lost.
fehler.neuere-datenbank.tun: Set the image back to the newer version (e.g. the tag :stabil) and restart the container. Going back to an older version is only possible with a backup made with that older version.
fehler.migration: The database could not be updated (step {nr} of {von}: {datei}, error code {code}). The database is unchanged, because all steps run in one transaction.
fehler.tun: The exact message is in the container’s log (docker logs with the container’s name, or in your NAS’s container manager under “Log”). The manual page “Troubleshooting” helps you with the message. Your data and backups are not affected.
fehler.neustart: Ablago will exit in a few minutes so that the container restarts and tries again.
api: Ablago is starting. Please try again in a few seconds.
api.fehler: Ablago could not start. The reason is shown on the start page and in the container’s log.
